senses.gloss: m. (preced.) lime-burner, worker in lime, plasterer.
units: <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 9:8">Koh. R. to IX, 8</cite> <he>הלך הס׳ לסִידוֹ</he> the lime-burner went to his lime (workshop). [<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Batra 2:17">Tosef. B. Bath. II, 17</cite> <he>בסייד</he>, read: <he>בסִיד</he>.]—Pl. <he>סַיָּידִים</he>, <he>סַיָּידִין</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Eduyot 2:8">Eduy. II, 8</cite>, a. e. <he>סנדל של ס׳</he> the (wooden) sandal of the lime-burners; a. e.
